note: Private exchange in the orchard establishes intimacy and a new object-based trust; scene is brief but registers a transfer and a promise.
Discovery of a scrap in the crate lining raises the stakes slightly; Mistress Anne's choice to observe rather than report creates a delayed tension.
The revelation and Evelyn's confession escalate the story; a hearing is set and the house's law asserts itself, displacing private attachments.
